title.narrative: Livestock: Enhanced Smallholder Livestock Investment Programme

description.narrative: The programme goal is to sustainably improve the incomes of poor rural households in targeted provinces and districts. The programme development objective will be to sustainably improve the production and productivity of key livestock systems of targeted women and men smallholder producers in selected provinces of Zambia.
